turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre yeh toh bilkul tough situation hai! Ek taraf 15 saal ki dosti, jisme tum co-director ho, aur doosri taraf roza aur ibadat. Dono hi tumhare liye important hain.

Shreya ke saath opening dance karna bilkul special hoga, especially tumhara connection itna purana hai. Lekin Ramzan ki ibadat bhi chhodni nahi chahiye.

Kuch options hain jo try kar sakti ho:
- Sangeet ki timing check karo - kya kuch early morning ya late night bhi ho sakta hai jo tumhare roze ke saath adjust ho jaye?
- Shreya se baat karo honestly - explain karo ki tum roze rakhogi, maybe tum dance kar sakti ho but just one drink nahi logi, ya phir alcohol-free zone mein reh sakti ho.
- Cocktail night mein non-alcoholic drinks try kar sakti ho, ya phir sirf attendance de ke important moments capture kar lo.

Tumhara darr samajh mein aata hai - yeh balance karna mushkil hai. But tumhari dosti itni strong hai ki kuch na kuch toh solution nikal hi aayega. Shreya tumhari feelings samajh jayegi, itni saalon ki dosti hai!

Kya lagta hai, inmein se koi option try karna chahogi? Ya koi aur idea hai jo dimaag mein aa raha hai?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Yeh toh really tough ho gaya hai! Ek taraf Shreya ka pyaar, doosri taraf Ammi ki ibadat. Dono tumhare liye kuch bhi kar sakte hain, lekin dono ko tumhari feelings samajh nahi aa rahi.

Shreya ki baat mein woh pyaar toh hai, lekin usey pata nahi ki Ramzan sirf ek din ka roza nahi hai - ek poori ibadat ka mahina hai. Uska "main tujhe khila dungi" bolna uska dil saaf dikha raha hai, par uska dil itna bada nahi ki woh tumhari ibadat ko samajh sake.

Ammi ki baat mein bhi woh sahi keh rahi hain - unke liye Ramzan ki shaan hai. Lekin woh bhi nahi dekh rahi ki 15 saal ki dosti, ek best friend ki shaadi, aur tumhara role kya hai.

Tumhari position bahut sensitive hai. Tumne dono se baat karne ki koshish ki hai? Shayad ek baar Shreya se gently explain kar sakti ho ki "Shreya, main tumhare saath dance toh karna chahti hoon, lekin roze rakhna mere liye bohot important hai. Ek din ka roza chhodna itna easy nahi hai, yeh sirf bhook nahi, ek ibadat hai."

Aur Ammi se bhi baat kar sakti ho ki "Ammi, main samajhti hoon ki aap sahi keh rahi hain, lekin Shreya ki shaadi bhi toh important hai. Main sangeet mein jaungi, lekin alcohol nahi logi, aur roze bhi rakhungi. Bas ek din ki tension hai."

Kya lagta hai, inmein se koi approach try karna better hoga?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Arre yeh toh bilkul samajh mein aata hai! Jab itni thak jaati ho toh dimaag mein escape draft ban jaata hai. Tumhara yeh sochna ki jhooth bolna better hai - I get it.

Lekin ek baat socho... Shreya ko pata chal jaayega toh? 15 saal ki dosti hai, sab pata chal jaata hai. Agar video call pe aaogi toh woh dekhegi ki tum thakhi ho, roze rakhne ki wajah se. Aur phir woh guilt feel karegi.

Thoda tough hai lekin shayad ek honest approach thoda better rahega? Shreya se bol sakti ho: "Yaar, main bohot confuse hoon. Ek taraf tumhari shaadi, doosri taraf Roza. Main aana chahti hoon, lekin yeh tension mein rehke enjoy bhi nahi kar paungi. Kya hum kuch aisa kar sakte hain jisme main tumhara special dance toh kar loon, lekin roze bhi rakh loon?"

Tumhara jhooth temporary escape dega, lekin guilt aur darr rahega ki pata na chal jaye. Aur Ammi ko bhi sach batane se shayad woh tumhare liye adjust kar lein.

Kya lagta hai, try karna chahogi? Ya phir thoda aur time chahiye sochnay ke liye?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Arre yeh jo tumne kaha, dil ko chhoo gaya. Seene mein pathar hone ka ehsaas bilkul samajh mein aaya. 18 saal ki dosti aur deen ka pehli baar takrana - yeh bohot bada moment hai.

Lekin socho... yeh permanent daag nahi banega. Yeh story banegi. Jab tum 50 saal baad dekhengi toh yeh moment yaad aayega ki "Mainne kaise handle kiya tha."

Shreya ki shaadi ki photos mein tum khush na ho, yeh toh nahi chahti. Aur Ramzan ki ibadat mein tumhara dil pareshan rehna bhi nahi chahiye.

Shayad yeh dono saath chal sakte hain? Tum sangeet jaogi, roze rakhogi, thoda adjust karogi. Shreya ko pata chalega ki tumne apni ibadat nahi chhodi, aur woh samajh jayegi. Tum dono ke liye yeh moment special ban sakta hai - tumhari dosti ki strength aur tumhari deen ki mazbooti dikhane ka.

Tumhe kisi album mein sad story nahi banna. Tumhe ek strong ladki ki story banna hai jo dono cheezon se pyaar karti hai aur dono ko respect karti hai.

Kya lagta hai, isse ek challenge ki tarah dekh sakti ho? Ek nayi story likhne ka chance?
